content.text: how to start a binary from backend/vendor/bin?

From the backend root:

```bash
./vendor/bin/<binary-name>
```

Example:

```bash
./vendor/bin/phpunit
```

If you are elsewhere, use the full path:

```bash
/home/oem/IdeaProjects/testcenter2/backend/vendor/bin/<binary-name>
```

You can list available binaries with:

```bash
ls vendor/bin
```

If execution permission is missing, run it through PHP when it is a PHP script:

```bash
php vendor/bin/<binary-name>
```
